title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy

maps.tested: Reported once by name in a consolidated recall.
maps.specifics: Reported: 'fiscal and monetary policy.' Your ledger carries LO 104.c as introduced but unresolved: the interest-growth differential and the risks of high public debt. That is a live open item, not new coverage.

vardeezReading: CI-5: Important, with the note "Solve book-wise Current Issues questions; anything can show up."

selectors.name: Fiscal-monetary interaction and fiscal dominance
selectors.what: How fiscal and monetary policy interact, including the tension that high public debt creates: fiscal dominance, where monetary policy is constrained by fiscal pressures (spending pressure sets a floor on fiscal flexibility and rate rises could spark a sovereign debt crisis), and the remedy of strong safeguards for central bank independence.

selectors.name: Interest-growth differential and high public debt
selectors.what: The interest-growth differential (interest rate minus economic growth: rates below growth help public finances, rates above growth strain them) and the risks of high public debt: strained public finances, debt working against monetary tightening, and financial stability risks.

notSelected: CI-5 a beyond the fiscal-monetary interaction (the two channels and the definition of the region of stability) and all of CI-5 b (consequences of breaching the region's boundaries in advanced and emerging economies) carry no shape beyond S1, no Map point and no Vardeez pointer; within CI-5 c, only the interest-growth differential, the high-debt risks and the fiscal-monetary tension are selected.
